title: Raw error codes shown to users ('team_not_found', 'invalid_regex'); error toast is hidden behind the 'Index a codebase' FAB
repro_steps: Team > Join with ID + bogus code 'zzzz'; Search with Regex on and '(['
expected: Human-readable error messages, toast fully visible
actual: Inline text 'team_not_found' and 'invalid_regex'; red toast text cut off under the FAB ('…ot found', '…regex'). Empty Join is disabled with no hint
fix_note: Raw dx error tokens ('team_not_found', 'invalid_regex', 22 more) reached the user verbatim at every DxWorkbench error funnel and the DevToolingPulse throw. All funnels now pass through one translator (components/dx-platform/errorWords.ts) holding the domain's vocabulary read from server/domains/dx-platform.js and dx.js; an unseen snake_case token falls back to a worded server-failure sentence, never the raw token. Named: the ticket's hidden-toast leg — the error renders are in-flow paragraphs, not a toast layer, so the layering claim is not code-verifiable from this seat. Disclosure: the shipped SARIF-export test pinned the raw 'handler_error' text; its one assertion now expects the translated sentence. The fix was merged onto the dx-platform-017 head (0e5f59409) with that section's hunks preserved. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Raw error codes in Empirical tools ('expr_required', 'fromUnits_and_toUnits_required'); Claim Scanner shows nothing for junk
repro_steps: Platform > Empirical: evaluate junk expression, convert with bad units, scan junk text
fix_note: The Empirical tools rendered raw server tokens ('expr_required', 'fromUnits_and_toUnits_required'). The panel now translates the empirical handlers' vocabulary (server/emergent/index.js); messages the server already sends as sentences pass through unchanged. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Invalid deep link ?id=bogus123 opens an entry modal showing the raw 'unknown_event' alert; also a 400 from /api/lens/run in the console
actual: Raw error code in the modal
fix_note: A deep link with a bogus id opened the entry modal showing the raw 'unknown_event' token (lore.get returns it in the reason field). The modal now reads error ?? reason and shows its own plain sentence, 'No entry matches this link.' Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Decrypt picker: loading a non-.enc file shows no error and keeps the previous file name
fix_note: Loading a non-.enc file in the decrypt picker showed the rejection but left the previous archive loaded and named ('Loaded: <old file>'), so the panel contradicted itself and the old envelope stayed decryptable. Both failure paths now clear the envelope and file name — after a rejection, nothing is loaded. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Create project and Validate hang disabled forever on API failure (no error, no retry)
repro_steps: With API 502: App name > SaaS > Create project; or Validate
actual: Spinner forever; Validate disabled after one 502
fix_note: Split scope. SILENT-FAILURE LEG fixed: ForgeWorkbench's Validate and Generate mutations fetch directly and their error state was never read — a failed call settled silently (spinner stopped, nothing appeared). Both failures now render a worded, retryable line under the header. CREATE-HANG LEG named, not discharged as reproduced: at branch state ForgeStudio's create path awaits lensRun, which catches internally and always resolves, so the creating flag always settles and the error speaks; the hang does not reproduce from code. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Add entrant: Enter key does not submit
repro_steps: Detail of an Upcoming tournament; type entrant name; press Enter
fix_note: The Add entrant form had no form element and no Enter binding, so Enter in the name field did nothing. The name and roster inputs now submit on Enter, through the same submitAdd the button calls (which already refuses a blank name). Reference behaviour: standard form semantics — Enter submits.

title: Quick actions (Generate Estimate/Invoice, Calculate P&L, Check Permits, Schedule Inspection) do nothing with no feedback when Project Desk empty
close_rule: Closes only after live re-run of original repro + nearby smoke on affected lens
fix_note: Two linked defects: handleAction returned in silence when no project target existed (the empty Project Desk case), and the failure message it set was rendered nowhere. An empty desk now sets a worded result — 'No project yet — add or select a project in the Project Desk first, then run this action on it.' — and the Action Result panel renders the message field, so server failures speak too.

title: Buttons with no feedback: Deployments Refresh, header '↓ .dtu'; topic 'paas' stuck on 'Pulling…' with 0 repos
repro_steps: Console > Deployments > Refresh; click '↓ .dtu'; Pulse topic paas
actual: Nothing visible; '.dtu' downloads nothing; paas shows REPOS 0 / Pulling…
fix_note: SPLIT. Deployments Refresh leg fixed: the button spun while loading and stopped with no outcome — a failed or empty refresh read exactly like a good one (load swallowed the failure). The tab now speaks the outcome ('Refreshed — N releases recorded.' / 'Could not refresh the releases — try again.'). The header '.dtu' leg is already cured at branch state — the shared DTUExportButton toasts on empty and verifies before declaring success. The topic 'paas' leg does not reproduce from front-end code: PlatformRepos settles its pending state on success or error, errors render a worded banner, and stale cache renders a worded notice — a hang would live in the lens/run path (server scope), named here for the desk.

title: Floating 'New shipment' button only switches tab (no form); New shipment form lacks items/date; EDI not generated from POD; compliance audit shows no output
expected: Opens form; EDI event; audit result
actual: Tab switch only; none; nothing visible
close_rule: Closes only after live re-run of original repro + nearby smoke on affected lens
fix_note: SPLIT. Button leg fixed: the page's 'New shipment' CTA only switched to the shipments tab; it now also bumps a create signal that opens ShipmentsPanel's create form. Date leg fixed: the create form gains an Estimated delivery date input, sent as the estimatedDelivery the server's shipments-create already accepts and stores. Named, not fixed: the line-items leg has no server field on a shipment — front-end items would fabricate storage, so it is a server-shape build for the desk; the EDI-from-POD leg is an unbuilt feature (no EDI generation exists in the delivery-proof surface), not a miswired control. The compliance-audit leg does not reproduce: runComplianceAudit renders its result and words every failure, including the empty-shipments case.
